_readme: Runtime settings for diligencebio.ai. Retune values here instead of editing source. Loaded by src/scripts/settings.ts on every page load; any key that is missing or malformed falls back to the default compiled into the consuming module, so a broken file here degrades gracefully rather than breaking the site. One section per drawn panel — "emergence" is the landing hero, the rest are named for their page — plus "nav" for the site header. Add new top-level sections as siblings of these.
_units: Every *Seconds value is in seconds. Every "speed" is a multiplier on playback: 2 runs twice as fast, 0.5 half. Every "mono" drops the accent colour and draws in ink only.

nav._note: Site header. hoverMenus opens the Services and Science menus of sub-pages on hover or keyboard focus. Off by default: each label already links to the index page that lists those sub-pages as cards, so nothing is unreachable without it. Off is also what you get with no JavaScript or an unreachable settings file.

emergence._note: Landing hero: 340 particles easing between ten formations.

services._note: Four scenes, one per service, cycling in this order. Each *Seconds is how long that scene holds before the panel advances.

science._note: Two scenes: the measurement layer, then the generalizability frontier.

company._note: One story on a loop: the same flaw caught at discovery and at Phase III. loopSeconds is how long one telling takes; the beats inside keep their relative timing.

requestAccess._note: One email's journey through screening and into the inbox. loopSeconds is how long one journey takes.
